verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription-monetization backend and SaaS platform, not an agent or AI host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers falls outside its product role. Its documented MCP server (docs-9) and AI Toolkit for your own coding agent (docs-17) are server- and integration-side and do not count here. The in-product assistant Rico (docs-10) answers questions about RevenueCat data, but nothing shows it consuming external MCP servers.
